C1286.title: Debt Bearer Loan Fraud: Packaging Companies Advance Social Security and Housing Fund Payments to Fabricate Borrower Profiles
C1286.summary: Investigations reveal that 'debt bearers' with no employment, social security, or housing fund records are being propped up by packaging companies. These firms advance payments for local social security and housing funds to simulate stable employment, and fabricate assets such as properties and businesses.
